==Notes==
*The shield animation which appears when casting this spell always faces the north.
*The words "Bork! Bork! Bork!" appear at the end of this skill's [[Bork! Bork! Bork!]] [[concise description]].
{{bug|The armor bonus while fighting Destroyers is calculated as two sources, the initial +24 armor and then the +24 armor against Destroyers. The armor bonus is therefore capped at +25 armor due to [[effect stacking]] (giving a 35.2% [[damage reduction]] bonus).}}
